definitions.explanation: The state of a company or business going bankrupt and being unable to pay its debts. Specifically refers to corporate/business bankruptcy rather than personal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{倒産|とうさん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many companies went bankrupt due to the recession.

examples.japanese: {倒産|とうさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{瀕|ひん}している→瀕する：13401_hinsuru⟧。
examples.english: They are on the verge of bankruptcy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{倒産|とうさん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{失業|しつぎょう}→失業：03179_shitsugyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His company went bankrupt, and he became unemployed.

notes:
USAGE: {倒産|とうさん} specifically refers to corporate or business bankruptcy. For personal bankruptcy, use ⟦{破産|はさん}→破産：03555_hasan⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {倒産|とうさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to go bankrupt - company)
- {倒産|とうさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれる→追い込まれる：noentry⟧ (to be driven to bankruptcy)
- {倒産|とうさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧ (risk of bankruptcy)
- ⟦{連鎖|れんさ}→連鎖：10903_rensa⟧{倒産|とうさん} (chain/domino bankruptcies)

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{破産|はさん}→破産：03555_hasan⟧:
- {倒産|とうさん} - corporate/business bankruptcy
- ⟦{破産|はさん}→破産：03555_hasan⟧ - personal bankruptcy, general insolvency

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{破産|はさん}→破産：03555_hasan⟧ (personal bankruptcy)
- ⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧ (to collapse, fall)
- ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦{破綻|はたん}→破綻：09066_hatan⟧ (management failure)
- ⟦{廃業|はいぎょう}→廃業：20645_haigyou⟧ (closing a business)
